module.purpose: Central barrel (re-export) module for the Cal.com platform packages layer. It aggregates booking handlers, payments, workflows, calendar, auth, team, and utility functions/types from across the monorepo so external platform consumers can import them from a single entry point.
module.summary: This file is a pure aggregation module with no business logic of its own. It imports booking-related functions (getBookingForReschedule, getBookingInfo, handleCancelBooking, handleNewBooking, handleInstantMeeting, getBookingFieldsWithSystemFields), phone verification, phone call creation, no-show marking, routing-form URL resolution, crypto helpers, i18n translation, payment client secret retrieval, Prisma selects, and team member invite utilities, then re-exports them alongside a large set of direct re-exports including Prisma enums, error codes, booking limits, recurring event parsing, round-robin reassignment, calendar links, attribute matching, admin/owner checks, email/phone verification flows, TeamService, CacheService, SelectedCalendarRepository, and API key creation. It also defines an exported TeamQuery Prisma payload type. Its architecture role is to provide a stable, single import surface (packages/platform/libraries) used by platform embed/API consumers to access internal Cal.com capabilities.
module.businessContext: Serves Cal.com's scheduling platform by exposing internal booking, team, payment, and verification capabilities through one public library surface. If it breaks, platform consumers lose access to core scheduling and account operations.
